description: TabM training configuration for macroparameter inference

notes.embeddings: Feature embeddings are CRITICAL for good performance. Type can be 'piecewise_linear', 'periodic', or 'linear_relu'
notes.learning_rate: TabM paper default: 0.002. Tune in range LogUniform[1e-4, 5e-3]
notes.weight_decay: TabM paper default: 0.0003. Tune in range {0, LogUniform[1e-4, 1e-1]}
notes.d_embedding: Tune in range UniformInt[8, 32, step=4] for piecewise_linear
notes.n_bins: Tree-based bins adapt to data. For quantile bins, tune UniformInt[2, 128]
notes.measurement_noise: Recommended: 0.5 cm for robustness to real-world measurement errors
